# Decisions

Architecture and infrastructure decisions, oldest first.

An ADR is identified by its filename — the date orders it, the slug names it.
Prose cites the slug alone: `(ADR terminal-transport)`. There is no number to
allocate, so two branches can add an ADR without colliding. Add one with
`mise run adr:new -- "Title of the decision"`.
